Volume 61 Tables 1: Chancellors 1

Chapter 61

1
唐因隋舊，以三省長官為宰相，已而又以他官參議，而稱號不一，出於臨時，最後乃有同品、平章之名，然其為職業則一也。 作宰相表。
Following Sui practice, Tang treated the chiefs of the Three Departments as chancellors; later other officials joined in deliberation as well, but their titles were inconsistent and often ad hoc, until at last designations such as "same rank" and Pingzhang appeared—though the office itself remained one. Here begins the Chancellor Table.
2
六月甲戌，趙國公世民為尚書令，相國長史裴寂拜尚書右僕射，知政事； 相國司馬劉文靜為納言； 隋民部尚書宋國公蕭瑀、相國司錄參軍竇威並為內史令。
In the sixth month, on jiaxu, Duke of Zhao Shimin was named Director of the Department of State Affairs; Pei Ji, chief administrator of the chancellor's office, was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and charged with state affairs; Liu Wenjing, marshal of the chancellor's office, was appointed Chief of the Palace Secretariat; Xiao Yu, Duke of Song and former Sui Minister of the Household, and Dou Wei, registrar of the chancellor's office, were both appointed Directors of the Secretariat.
3
庚辰，世民封秦王。
On gengchen, Shimin was enfeoffed as Prince of Qin.
4
癸未，世民為西討元帥； 壬辰，為雍州牧。
On guiwei, Shimin was made commander-in-chief of the western expedition; On renchen, he was appointed Governor of Yongzhou.
5
辛丑，威薨。 將作大匠襲陳國公竇抗本官兼納言，黃門侍郎陳叔達判納言。
On xinchou, Dou Wei died. Dou Kang, Duke of Chen and chief director of palace construction, retained his original post and was additionally named Chief of the Palace Secretariat; Yellow Gate Attendant Chen Shuda served concurrently as acting Chief of the Palace Secretariat.
6
八月己丑，世民為西討行軍元帥。
In the eighth month, on jichou, Shimin was made commander-in-chief of the western expedition field army.
7
戊申，文靜除名。
On wushen, Liu Wenjing was dismissed and expunged from the rolls.
8
十月，抗罷為左武候大將軍。
In the tenth month, Dou Kang was relieved and appointed General of the Left Martial Guard.
9
十二月壬申，秦王世民為太尉、陝東道行臺尚書令。
In the twelfth month, on renshen, Prince of Qin Shimin was named Grand Marshal and Director of the Shaanxi East Circuit Mobile Secretariat.
10
正月甲子，叔達兼納言。
In the first month, on jiazi, Chen Shuda was additionally charged as Chief of the Palace Secretariat.
11
十月己亥，黃門侍郎、涼州總管楊恭仁遙領納言。
In the tenth month, on jihai, Yellow Gate Attendant and Liangzhou Commander-in-Chief Yang Gongren held the title of Chief of the Palace Secretariat in absentia.
12
三月甲戌，中書侍郎封德彝兼中書令。
In the third month, on jiaxu, Secretariat Attendant Feng Deyi was additionally named Director of the Secretariat.
13
四月甲寅，世民為益州道行臺尚書令。
In the fourth month, on jiayin, Shimin was appointed Director of the Yizhou Circuit Mobile Secretariat.
14
正月，德彝判吏部尚書。
In the first month, Feng Deyi served concurrently as acting Minister of Personnel.
15
四月癸酉，寂為左僕射。
In the fourth month, on guiyou, Pei Ji was appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
16
十月己丑，齊王元吉為司空，世民加司徒、天策上將。
In the tenth month, on jichou, Prince of Qi Li Yuanji was named Minister of Works; Shimin was promoted to Minister of Education and Heavenly Strategist General.
17
十月甲子，世民領左、右十二衛大將軍
In the tenth month, on jiazi, Shimin took command of the generals of the Left and Right Twelve Guards.
18
四月癸酉，德彝為中書令； 恭仁入為吏部尚書兼中書令，檢校涼州諸軍事； 瑀為尚書右僕射； 寂為左僕射。
In the fourth month, on guiyou, Feng Deyi was appointed Director of the Secretariat; Yang Gongren entered the capital as Minister of Personnel and concurrent Director of the Secretariat, with supervisory authority over Liangzhou military affairs; Xiao Yu was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Pei Ji was appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
19
十二月庚午，太子詹事裴矩檢校侍中。
In the twelfth month, on gengwu, Pei Ju, administrator of the crown prince's household, was made acting supervisor of the Palace Secretariat.
20
十一月辛卯，矩罷判黃門侍郎。
In the eleventh month, on xinmao, Pei Ju was relieved of his concurrent duty as acting Yellow Gate Attendant.
21
庚子，天策府司馬宇文士及權檢校侍中兼太子詹事。
On gengzi, Yuwen Shiji, marshal of the Heavenly Strategist Office, was provisionally made acting supervisor of the Palace Secretariat and concurrent administrator of the crown prince's household.
22
癸卯，世民加中書令，元吉加侍中。
On guimao, Shimin was promoted to Director of the Secretariat and Yuanji to Palace Secretariat Attendant.
23
六月癸亥，世民為皇太子。
In the sixth month, on guihai, Shimin was established as crown prince.
24
七月辛卯，太子右庶子高士廉為侍中，左庶子房玄齡為中書令，蕭瑀為尚書左僕射。 恭仁罷。
In the seventh month, on xinmao, Gao Shilian, right senior support of the crown prince, was named Palace Secretariat Attendant; Fang Xuanling, left senior support, was named Director of the Secretariat; and Xiao Yu was appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs. Yang Gongren was dismissed.
25
癸巳，士及為中書令，德彝為尚書右僕射。
On guisi, Yuwen Shiji was appointed Director of the Secretariat and Feng Deyi Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
26
十月庚辰，叔達、瑀坐事免。
In the tenth month, on gengchen, Chen Shuda and Xiao Yu were dismissed for misconduct.
27
正月甲寅，裴寂為司空。
In the first month, on jiayin, Pei Ji was appointed Minister of Works.
28
二月庚申，元吉為司徒。
In the second month, on gengshen, Li Yuanji was named Minister of Education.
29
六月庚申，元吉誅。
In the sixth month, on gengshen, Li Yuanji was put to death.
30
六月辛丑，德彝薨。
In the sixth month, on renchen, Feng Deyi died.
31
壬辰，太子少師蕭瑀為尚書左僕射。
On renchen, Xiao Yu, junior preceptor of the crown prince, was appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
32
七月壬子，吏部尚書長孫無忌為尚書右僕射。
In the seventh month, on renzi, Zhangsun Wuji, Minister of Personnel, was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
33
八月，士及檢校涼州都督。
In the eighth month, Yuwen Shiji was made acting area commander of Liangzhou.
34
戊戌，士廉貶為安州大都督。
On wuxu, Gao Shilian was demoted to area commander of Anzhou.
35
九月辛酉，御史大夫杜淹檢校吏部尚書，參豫朝政。 士及罷為殿中監。
In the ninth month, on xinyou, Censor-in-Chief Du Yan was made acting supervisor of the Ministry of Personnel and joined deliberations on court affairs. Yuwen Shiji was relieved and appointed supervisor of the palace domestic office.
36
十二月壬午，瑀罷。
In the twelfth month, on renwu, Xiao Yu was dismissed.
37
正月辛亥，兵部尚書杜如晦檢校侍中，攝吏部尚書，仍總監東宮兵馬事。 無忌罷。
In the first month, on xinhai, Du Ruhui, Minister of War, was made acting supervisor of the Palace Secretariat, acting Minister of Personnel, and continued to oversee the crown prince's military and cavalry affairs. Zhangsun Wuji was dismissed.
38
庚午，刑部尚書李靖檢校中書令。
On gengwu, Li Jing, Minister of Justice, was made acting supervisor of the Secretariat.
39
三月壬戌，靖為關內道行軍大總管。
In the third month, on renxu, Li Jing was appointed grand general of the Guannei Circuit field army.
40
七月戊申，玄齡兼太子詹事。
In the seventh month, on wushen, Fang Xuanling was additionally named administrator of the crown prince's household.
41
十月庚辰，淹薨。
In the tenth month, on gengchen, Du Yan died.
42
十二月壬辰，黃門侍郎王珪守侍中。
In the twelfth month, on renchen, Yellow Gate Attendant Wang Gui served as acting Palace Secretariat Attendant.
43
二月戊寅，房玄齡為尚書左僕射； 杜如晦為右僕射； 尚書右丞魏徵為祕書監，參豫朝政； 靖為兵部尚書。
In the second month, on wuyin, Fang Xuanling was appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Du Ruhui was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Wei Zheng, right director of the Department of State Affairs, was named Director of the Secretariat Library and joined deliberations on court affairs; Li Jing was appointed Minister of War.
44
八月，靖為定襄道行軍大總督。
In the eighth month, Li Jing was made grand commander of the Dingxiang Circuit field army.
45
十二月癸未，如晦罷。
In the twelfth month, on guiwei, Du Ruhui was dismissed.
46
正月辛未，寂免。
In the first month, on xinwei, Pei Ji was dismissed from office.
47
二月甲寅，珪為侍中； 太常卿蕭瑀為御史大夫，參議朝政； 御史大夫溫彥博為中書令； 民部尚書戴冑檢校吏部尚書，參豫朝政。
In the second month, on jiayin, Wang Gui was appointed Palace Secretariat Attendant; Xiao Yu, director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was named Censor-in-Chief and joined deliberations on court affairs; Wen Yanbo, Censor-in-Chief, was appointed Director of the Secretariat; Dai Zhou, Minister of the Household, was made acting supervisor of the Ministry of Personnel and joined deliberations on court affairs.
48
七月癸酉，瑀罷為太子少傅。
In the seventh month, on guiyou, Xiao Yu was relieved and appointed junior preceptor of the crown prince.
49
八月甲寅，靖為尚書右僕射。
In the eighth month, on jiayin, Li Jing was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
50
十一月壬戌，右衛大將軍侯君集為兵部尚書，參豫朝政。
In the eleventh month, on renxu, Hou Junji, general of the Right Guard, was named Minister of War and joined deliberations on court affairs.
51
三月，君集以喪罷。
In the third month, Hou Junji stepped down to observe mourning.
52
五月，徵檢校侍中。
In the fifth month, Wei Zheng was made acting supervisor of the Palace Secretariat.
53
十月，君集起復。
In the tenth month, Hou Junji resumed office after mourning.
54
三月戊子，珪罷為同州刺史。
In the third month, on wuzi, Wang Gui was relieved and appointed prefect of Tongzhou.
55
庚寅，徵為侍中。
On gengyin, Wei Zheng was appointed Palace Secretariat Attendant.
56
六月辛亥，冑薨。
In the sixth month, on xinhai, Dai Zhou died.
57
十一月壬辰，開府儀同三司長孫無忌為司空。
In the eleventh month, on renchen, Zhangsun Wuji, honored companion of the first rank, was appointed Minister of Works.
58
十月丙寅，詔靖三兩日一至門下、中書，平章政事。
In the tenth month, on bingyin, an edict directed Li Jing to attend the Palace Secretariat and Secretariat every two or three days to deliberate jointly on state affairs.
59
十一月辛未，靖罷為特進。
In the eleventh month, on xinwei, Li Jing was relieved and given the rank of specially advanced.
60
十二月辛丑，君集為積石道行軍總管。
In the twelfth month, on xinchou, Hou Junji was appointed commander of the Jishi Circuit field army.
61
七月辛巳，恭仁罷為雍州牧。
In the seventh month, on xinsi, Yang Gongren was relieved and appointed Governor of Yongzhou.
62
十一月壬戌，特進蕭瑀參豫朝政。
In the eleventh month, on renxu, Xiao Yu, specially advanced, joined deliberations on court affairs.
63
二月，無忌以母喪罷。 五月，起復。
In the second month, Zhangsun Wuji stepped down to mourn his mother. In the fifth month, he resumed office after mourning.
64
六月壬申，彥博為尚書右僕射，太常卿楊師道為侍中，參豫朝政； 魏徵罷為特進，知門下省事，朝章國典，參議得失。
In the sixth month, on renshen, Wen Yanbo was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Yang Shidao, director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was named Palace Secretariat Attendant and joined deliberations on court affairs; Wei Zheng was relieved and made specially advanced with charge of Palace Secretariat affairs, deliberating on the merits and flaws of court regulations and state institutions.
65
十二月，瑀罷為岐州刺史。
In the twelfth month, Xiao Yu was relieved and appointed prefect of Qizhou.
66
六月甲寅，彥博薨。
In the sixth month, on jiayin, Wen Yanbo died.
67
七月癸酉，吏部尚書高士廉為尚書右僕射。
In the seventh month, on guiyou, Gao Shilian, Minister of Personnel, was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
68
八月戊寅，君集為吏部尚書； 壬寅，為當彌道行軍大總管。
In the eighth month, on wuyin, Hou Junji was appointed Minister of Personnel; On renyin, he was made grand commander of the Dangmi Circuit field army.
69
正月，玄齡為太子少師。
In the first month, Fang Xuanling was named junior preceptor of the crown prince.
70
十一月辛亥，師道為中書令。
In the eleventh month, on xinhai, Yang Shidao was appointed Director of the Secretariat.
71
戊辰，尚書左丞劉洎為黃門侍郎，參知政事。
On wuchen, Liu Ji, left director of the Department of State Affairs, was named Yellow Gate Attendant and joined in managing state affairs.
72
十二月壬申，君集為交河道行軍大總管。
In the twelfth month, on renshen, Hou Junji was appointed grand commander of the Jiaozhi Circuit field army.
73
十二月，君集還。
In the twelfth month, Hou Junji returned from campaign.
74
正月辛未，中書舍人兼侍郎岑文本為中書侍郎，專典機密。
In the first month, on xinwei, Cen Wenben, draftsman of the Secretariat and concurrent attendant, was promoted to Secretariat Attendant with exclusive charge of confidential affairs.
75
九月丁巳，徵罷為太子太師。
In the ninth month, on dingsi, Wei Zheng was relieved and appointed grand preceptor of the crown prince.
76
七月戊午，無忌為司徒，玄齡為司空。
In the seventh month, on wuwu, Zhangsun Wuji was named Minister of Education and Fang Xuanling Minister of Works.
77
四月乙酉，君集誅。
In the fourth month, on yiyou, Hou Junji was put to death.
78
丁亥，師道罷為吏部尚書。
On dinghai, Yang Shidao was relieved and appointed Minister of Personnel.
79
己丑，特進蕭瑀為太子太保，兵部尚書李世勣為特進、太子詹事，並同中書門下三品。
On jichou, Xiao Yu, specially advanced, was named grand guardian of the crown prince; Li Shiji, Minister of War, was made specially advanced and administrator of the crown prince's household, both with rank equal to the chiefs of the Three Departments.
80
六月丁酉，士廉為開府儀同三司、同中書門下三品，平章政事。
In the sixth month, on dingyou, Gao Shilian was named honored companion of the first rank, with rank equal to the chiefs of the Three Departments, and charged to deliberate jointly on state affairs.
81
七月丁酉，玄齡以母喪罷。
In the seventh month, on dingyou, Fang Xuanling stepped down to mourn his mother.
82
八月庚戌，工部尚書張亮為刑部尚書，參豫朝政。
In the eighth month, on gengxu, Zhang Liang, Minister of Works, was named Minister of Justice and joined deliberations on court affairs.
83
十月丁巳，玄齡起復。
In the tenth month, on dingsi, Fang Xuanling resumed office after mourning.
84
七月丁酉，玄齡以母喪罷。 十月丁巳，起復。
In the seventh month, on dingyou, Fang Xuanling stepped down to mourn his mother. In the tenth month, on dingsi, he resumed office after mourning.
85
八月丁卯，洎為侍中，文本為中書令，中書侍郎馬周守中書令。
In the eighth month, on dingmao, Liu Ji was appointed Palace Secretariat Attendant; Cen Wenben was named Director of the Secretariat; and Secretariat Attendant Ma Zhou served as acting Director of the Secretariat.
86
九月，黃門侍郎褚遂良參豫朝政。
In the ninth month, Chu Suiliang, Yellow Gate Attendant, joined deliberations on court affairs.
87
十一月甲子，世勣、周為遼東道行軍大總管。
In the eleventh month, on jiazi, Li Shiji and Ma Zhou were appointed grand commanders of the Liaodong Circuit field army.
88
二月乙卯，士廉攝太子太傅，劉洎、馬周、太子左庶子許敬宗、右庶子高季輔、少詹事張行成同掌機務。
In the second month, on yimao, Gao Shilian served as acting grand preceptor of the crown prince; Liu Ji, Ma Zhou, Xu Jingzong, left senior support of the crown prince, Gao Jifu, right senior support, and Zhang Xingcheng, junior household administrator, jointly managed confidential state affairs.
89
三月壬辰，楊師道攝中書令，無忌攝侍中。
In the third month, on renchen, Yang Shidao served as acting Director of the Secretariat and Zhangsun Wuji as acting Palace Secretariat Attendant.
90
四月丁未，文本薨。
In the fourth month, on dingwei, Cen Wenben died.
91
十一月丁亥，師道貶為工部尚書。
In the eleventh month, on dinghai, Yang Shidao was demoted to Minister of Works.
92
十二月庚申，洎賜死。
In the twelfth month, on gengshen, Liu Ji was condemned to death.
93
三月己丑，亮誅。
In the third month, on jichou, Zhang Liang was put to death.
94
四月甲子，瑀罷太子太保。 十月，貶商州刺史。
In the fourth month, on jiazi, Xiao Yu was relieved as grand guardian of the crown prince. In the tenth month, he was demoted to prefect of Shangzhou.
95
正月壬辰，士廉薨。
In the first month, on renchen, Gao Shilian died.
96
三月戊子，世勣為遼東道行軍大總管。
In the third month, on wuzi, Li Shiji was appointed grand commander of the Liaodong Circuit field army.
97
十月癸丑，遂良以父喪罷。
In the tenth month, on guichou, Chu Suiliang stepped down to mourn his father.
98
正月庚寅，周薨。
In the first month, on gengyin, Ma Zhou died.
99
己亥，中書舍人崔仁師為中書侍郎，參知機務。
On jihai, Cui Renshi, draftsman of the Secretariat, was promoted to Secretariat Attendant and joined in managing confidential affairs.
100
丙午，無忌檢校中書令，知尚書、門下三省事。
On bingwu, Zhangsun Wuji was made acting supervisor of the Secretariat with charge of the Department of State Affairs, Palace Secretariat, and Secretariat.
101
二月，遂良起復。 己卯，仁師除名，流于連州。
In the second month, Chu Suiliang resumed office after mourning. On jimao, Cui Renshi was dismissed, expunged from the rolls, and exiled to Lianzhou.
102
九月己亥，遂良為中書令。
In the ninth month, on jihai, Chu Suiliang was appointed Director of the Secretariat.
103
七月癸卯，玄齡薨。
In the seventh month, on guimao, Fang Xuanling died.
104
五月戊午，勣貶疊州都督。
In the fifth month, on wuwu, Li Ji was demoted to area commander of Diezhou.
105
庚午，行成兼侍中，檢校刑部尚書季輔兼中書令，禮部尚書于志寧為侍中。
On gengwu, Zhang Xingcheng was additionally named Palace Secretariat Attendant; Gao Jifu, acting Minister of Justice, was additionally named Director of the Secretariat; and Yu Zhining, Minister of Rites, was appointed Palace Secretariat Attendant.
106
癸巳，檢校洛州刺史李勣為開府儀同三司、同中書門下參掌機密。
On guisi, Li Ji, acting prefect of Luozhou, was named honored companion of the first rank and joined the chiefs of the Secretariat and Palace Secretariat in managing confidential affairs.
107
九月乙卯，李勣為尚書左僕射、同中書門下三品。
In the ninth month, on yimao, Li Ji was appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs with rank equal to the chiefs of the Three Departments.
108
六月癸未，無忌為太尉。
In the sixth month, on guiwei, Zhangsun Wuji was named Grand Marshal.
109

In the ninth month, on jiayin, Prince of Jing Li Yuanjing was named Minister of Education and Prince of Wu Li Ke Minister of Works.

正月丙午，行成為侍中。
In the first month, on bingwu, Zhang Xingcheng was appointed Palace Secretariat Attendant.
111

In the tenth month, on wuchen, Li Ji was relieved of the vice directorship.
112
十一月，遂良貶同州刺史。
In the eleventh month, Chu Suiliang was demoted to prefect of Tongzhou.

正月乙巳，黃門侍郎宇文節、中書侍郎柳奭並同中書門下三品。
In the first month, on yisi, Yuwen Jie, Yellow Gate Attendant, and Liu Shi, Secretariat Attendant, were both given rank equal to the chiefs of the Three Departments.

八月己巳，張行成為尚書右僕射、同中書門下三品，高季輔為侍中，志寧為尚書左僕射、同中書門下三品。
In the eighth month, on jisi, Zhang Xingcheng was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs with rank equal to the Three Departments; Gao Jifu was named Palace Secretariat Attendant; and Yu Zhining was named Left Vice Director with the same rank.

In the seventh month, on yichou, Zhang Xingcheng was additionally named junior preceptor of the crown prince; Gao Jifu junior guardian; Yu Zhining junior mentor; and Yuwen Jie administrator of the crown prince's household.
118
九月，守中書侍郎來濟同中書門下三品。
In the ninth month, Lai Ji, acting Secretariat Attendant, was given rank equal to the chiefs of the Three Departments.

236
八月丙午，承嗣罷為禮部尚書。
In the eighth month, on bingwu, Wu Chengsi was relieved and appointed Minister of Rites.

十月丁亥，鳳閣舍人李景諶同鳳閣鸞臺平章事，左肅政臺御史大夫騫味道檢校內史、同鳳閣鸞臺三品。
In the tenth month, on dinghai, Li Jingchen, Phoenix Pavilion draftsman, joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs; Su Weidao, Left Attendant Censor-in-Chief, was made acting supervisor of the Inner Secretariat with rank equal to the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
238
丙申，炎被殺。
On bingshen, Pei Yan was executed.
239
丁酉，景先貶辰州刺史，弘敏貶汾州刺史，景諶罷守司賓少卿。 守右史沈君諒、著作郎崔詧並為正諫大夫、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。
On dingyou, Liu Jingxian was demoted to prefect of Chenzhou; Wei Hongmin to prefect of Fenzhou; and Li Jingchen was relieved and served as acting director of the Court of Imperial Banquets. Shen Junliang, acting right historiographer, and Cui Cha, compilation director, were both named grand remonstrance masters and joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.
240
十一月丁卯，待舉罷為左庶子。 鸞臺侍郎韋方質守鳳閣侍郎、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。
In the eleventh month, on dingmao, Guo Daiju was relieved and appointed left senior support. Wei Fangzhi, Crane Pavilion Attendant, served as acting Phoenix Pavilion Attendant and joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.
241
正月戊辰，仁軌薨。
In the first month, on wuchen, Liu Rengui died.
242
庚戌，味道守內史、同三品。
On gengxu, Su Weidao served as acting director of the Inner Secretariat with rank equal to the Three Departments.
243
二月乙巳，承嗣同鳳閣鸞臺三品。 君諒罷。 右肅政臺御史大夫韋思謙、秋官尚書裴居道並同鳳閣鸞臺三品。
In the second month, on yisi, Wu Chengsi was given rank equal to the chiefs of the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions. Shen Junliang was dismissed. Wei Siqian, Right Attendant Censor-in-Chief, and Pei Judao, Minister of Punishments, were both given rank equal to the chiefs of the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
244
三月辛酉，承嗣罷，詧使河北，罷。
In the third month, on xinyou, Wu Chengsi was dismissed; Cui Cha was dispatched to Hebei and relieved.
245
四月丙子，味道貶青州刺史。
In the fourth month, on bingzi, Su Weidao was demoted to prefect of Qingzhou.
246
五月丙午，居道為內史。
In the fifth month, on bingwu, Pei Judao was named director of the Inner Secretariat.
247
丁未，德真罷為同州刺史，其日流象州。
On dingwei, Wang Dezhen was relieved and appointed prefect of Tongzhou; that same day he was exiled to Xiangzhou.
248
己酉，冬官尚書蘇良嗣守納言。
On jiyou, Su Liangsi, Minister of Winter Works, served as acting Chief of the Palace Secretariat.
249
壬申，方質同鳳閣鸞臺三品。
On renshen, Wei Fangzhi was given rank equal to the chiefs of the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
250
六月，天官尚書韋待價同鳳閣鸞臺三品。
In the sixth month, Wei Daizhi, Minister of Heaven, was given rank equal to the chiefs of the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
251
七月己酉，玄同自文昌左丞遷鸞臺侍郎。
In the seventh month, on jiyou, Wei Xuantong was transferred from left director of the Wenchang Bureau to Crane Pavilion Attendant.
252
十一月癸卯，待價為燕然道行軍大總管。
In the eleventh month, on guimao, Wei Daizhi was appointed grand commander of the Yanran Circuit field army.
253
十一月丙辰，元嘉自殺，元軌流黔州。
In the eleventh month, on bingchen, Li Yuanjia took his own life; Li Yuan Gui was exiled to Qianzhou.
254
三月丙辰，玄同為地官尚書。
In the third month, on bingchen, Wei Xuantong was named Minister of Earth.
255
四月庚辰，長倩為內史。
In the fourth month, on gengchen, Cen Changqian was named director of the Inner Secretariat.
256
五月丙午，居道為納言。
In the fifth month, on bingwu, Pei Judao was named Chief of the Palace Secretariat.
257
六月辛未，良嗣守文昌左相、同鳳閣鸞臺三品，待價守文昌右相。
In the sixth month, on xinwei, Su Liangsi served as acting left chief councillor of Wenchang with rank equal to the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions; Wei Daizhi served as acting right chief councillor of Wenchang.
258
己卯，思謙守納言。
On jimao, Wei Siqian served as acting Chief of the Palace Secretariat.
259
三月乙丑，思謙以太中大夫致仕。
In the third month, on yichou, Wei Siqian retired with the rank of Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.
260
四月壬戌，居道為納言。
In the fourth month, on renxu, Pei Judao was named Chief of the Palace Secretariat.
261
五月丙寅，夏官侍郎張光輔為鳳閣侍郎、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。
In the fifth month, on bingyin, Zhang Guangfu, Vice Minister of Summer, was named Phoenix Pavilion Attendant and joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.
262
庚午，禕之被殺。
On gengwu, Liu Yizhi was executed.
263
八月壬子，玄同兼檢校納言。
In the eighth month, on renzi, Wei Xuantong was additionally made acting supervisor of the Palace Secretariat.
264
十二月壬辰，待價為安息道行軍大總管。
In the twelfth month, on renchen, Wei Daizhi was appointed grand commander of the Anxi Circuit field army.
265
九月丁卯，左肅政臺御史大夫騫味道、夏官侍郎王本立並同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。
In the ninth month, on dingmao, Su Weidao, Left Attendant Censor-in-Chief, and Wang Benli, Vice Minister of Summer, joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.
266
丙辰，光輔為諸軍節度，長倩為後軍大總管，討越王貞。
On bingchen, Zhang Guangfu was named commander of all armies; Cen Changqian was made grand general of the rear army to suppress Li Zhen, Prince of Yue.
267
十二月己亥，味道被殺。
In the twelfth month, on jihai, Su Weidao was executed.
268
二月甲寅，方質守地官尚書。
In the second month, on jiayin, Wei Fangzhi served as acting Minister of Earth.
269
三月甲寅，本立守左肅政臺御史大夫。
In the third month, on jiayin, Wang Benli served as acting Left Attendant Censor-in-Chief.
270
甲子，光輔守納言。
On jiazi, Zhang Guangfu served as acting Chief of the Palace Secretariat.
271
癸酉，天官尚書武承嗣為納言，光輔守內史。
On guiyou, Wu Chengsi, Minister of Heaven, was named Chief of the Palace Secretariat; Zhang Guangfu served as acting director of the Inner Secretariat.
272
五月丙辰，待價為安息道行軍總管。
In the fifth month, on bingchen, Wei Daizhi was appointed commander of the Anxi Circuit field army.
273
七月丙子，待價流繡州。
In the seventh month, on bingzi, Wei Daizhi was exiled to Xiuzhou.
274
戊寅，本立同鳳閣鸞臺三品。
On wuyin, Wang Benli was given rank equal to the chiefs of the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
275
八月甲申，光輔被殺。
In the eighth month, on jiashen, Zhang Guangfu was executed.
276
閏九月甲午，玄同被殺。
In the intercalary ninth month, on jiawu, Wei Xuantong was executed.

十月丁卯，春官尚書范履冰、鳳閣侍郎邢文偉並同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

正月丁巳，元名為司徒。
In the first month, on dingsi, Li Yuanming was named Minister of Education.
279
一月戊子，承嗣為文昌左相，長倩為文昌右相，並同鳳閣鸞臺三品。 良嗣為特進，本立罷為地官尚書，文偉守內史，鳳閣侍郎武攸寧納言，居道為太子少保。
In the first month, on wuzi, Wu Chengsi was named left chief councillor of Wenchang and Cen Changqian right chief councillor of Wenchang, both with rank equal to the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions. Su Liangsi was made specially advanced; Wang Benli was relieved and appointed Minister of Earth; Xing Wenwei served as acting director of the Inner Secretariat; Wu Youning, Phoenix Pavilion Attendant, was named Chief of the Palace Secretariat; and Pei Judao junior guardian of the crown prince.
280
甲午，方質流于儋州。
On jiawu, Wei Fangzhi was exiled to Danzhou.
281
三月丁亥，良嗣薨。
In the third month, on dinghai, Su Liangsi died.
282
四月丁巳，履冰被殺。
In the fourth month, on dingsi, Fan Lubing was executed.
283
八月甲寅，居道下獄死。
In the eighth month, on jiayin, Pei Judao died in prison.

九月丙戌，給事中傅游藝為鸞臺侍郎、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事，司賓卿史務滋守納言，鳳閣侍郎宗秦客檢校納言。
In the ninth month, on bingxu, Fu Youyi, draftsman, was named Crane Pavilion Attendant and joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs; Shi Wuzi, director of the Court of Imperial Banquets, served as acting Chief of the Palace Secretariat; and Zong Qinke, Phoenix Pavilion Attendant, was made acting supervisor of the Palace Secretariat.

十月甲子，秦客貶遵化尉。
In the tenth month, on jiazi, Zong Qinke was demoted to captain of Zunhua.

辛未，文偉貶珍州刺史。
On xinwei, Xing Wenwei was demoted to prefect of Zhenzhou.
287
七月辛巳，元名流和州。
In the seventh month, on xinsi, Li Yuanming was exiled to Hezhou.
288
一月庚子，務滋自殺。
In the first month, on gengzi, Shi Wuzi took his own life.
289
五月丁亥，長倩為武威道行軍大總管。
In the fifth month, on dinghai, Cen Changqian was appointed grand commander of the Wuwei Circuit field army.

六月庚戌，鸞臺侍郎樂思晦，鳳閣侍郎任知古，左肅政臺御史大夫格輔元為地官尚書，並同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。
In the sixth month, on gengxu, Yue Sihui, Crane Pavilion Attendant, Ren Zhigu, Phoenix Pavilion Attendant, and Ge Fuyuan, Left Attendant Censor-in-Chief and Minister of Earth, all joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.
291
癸卯，長倩為輔國大將軍。
On guimao, Cen Changqian was named assistant state-supporting grand general.

九月壬辰，游藝自殺。
In the ninth month, on renchen, Fu Youyi took his own life.

癸巳，攸寧守納言，冬官侍郎裴行本，洛州司馬狄仁傑守地官侍郎，並同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。
On guisi, Wu Youning served as acting Chief of the Palace Secretariat; Pei Xingben, Vice Minister of Winter, and Di Renjie, Luozhou marshal, served as acting Vice Ministers of Earth; all joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.
295
十月己酉，長倩、輔元、通被殺。
In the tenth month, on jiyou, Cen Changqian, Ge Fuyuan, and Ouyang Tong were executed.
296
壬戌，思晦被殺。
On renxu, Yue Sihui was executed.
297
一月戊辰，夏官尚書楊執柔同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。
In the first month, on wuchen, Yang Zhirou, Minister of Summer, joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.
298
庚午，知古貶江夏令，行本流嶺南，仁傑貶彭澤令。
On gengwu, Ren Zhigu was demoted to magistrate of Jiangxia; Pei Xingben was exiled to Lingnan; and Di Renjie was demoted to magistrate of Pengze.

庚辰，司刑卿李游道為冬官尚書、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。
On gengchen, Li Youdao, director of punishments, was named Minister of Winter and joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.
300
二月戊午，秋官尚書袁智弘同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。
In the second month, on wuwu, Yuan Zhihong, Minister of Autumn, joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.
301
八月戊寅，承嗣罷為特進，攸寧罷為冬官尚書，執柔罷守地官尚書。 司賓卿崔神基、秋官侍郎崔元綜、夏官侍郎李昭德、權檢校天官侍郎姚璹、守容州都督檢校地官侍郎李元素並同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。
In the eighth month, on wuyin, Wu Chengsi was relieved and made specially advanced; Wu Youning was relieved and appointed Minister of Winter; and Yang Zhirou was relieved and served as acting Minister of Earth. Cui Shenji, director of the Court of Imperial Banquets, Cui Yuanzong, Vice Minister of Autumn, Li Zhaode, Vice Minister of Summer, Yao Shuo, acting supervisor of Heaven, and Li Yuansu, acting Vice Minister of Earth and area commander of Rongzhou, all joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.
302
辛巳，營繕大匠王璿守夏官尚書、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。
On xinsi, Wang Xuan, chief director of construction, served as acting Minister of Summer and joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.
303
九月辛丑，璹罷為司賓少卿。
In the ninth month, on xinchou, Yao Shuo was relieved and appointed director of the Court of Imperial Banquets.

癸丑，游道、智弘、神基、元素、璿並流嶺南。
On guichou, Li Youdao, Yuan Zhihong, Cui Shenji, Li Yuansu, and Wang Xuan were all exiled to Lingnan.

一月庚子，夏官侍郎婁師德同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。
In the first month, on gengzi, Lou Shide, Vice Minister of Summer, joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

乙卯，昭德為夏官侍郎。
On yimao, Li Zhaode was named Vice Minister of Summer.

In the ninth month, on guichou, Wei Juyuan, right director of Wenchang, and Lu Yuanfang, Vice Minister of Autumn, were named Crane Pavilion Attendants and joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs. In the third month, on jiashen, Li Zhaode was made acting supervisor of the Inner Secretariat; Su Weidao, Phoenix Pavilion draftsman, was named Phoenix Pavilion Attendant and joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs; Zhaode was named chief administrator of the Shuofang Circuit field army and Weidao army marshal.

四月壬戌，夏官尚書、武威道大總管王孝傑同鳳閣鸞臺三品。
In the fourth month, on renxu, Wang Xiaojie, Minister of Summer and grand commander of the Wuwei Circuit, was given rank equal to the chiefs of the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.

312
八月，什方乞歸山，遣之。
In the eighth month, Wu Shifang asked to return to the mountains and was dismissed to go.
313
戊辰，孝傑為瀚海道行軍總管。
On wuchen, Wang Xiaojie was appointed commander of the Hanhai Circuit field army.

On jisi, Yao Shuo served as acting Chief of the Palace Secretariat; Yang Zaisi, Left Attendant Censor-in-Chief, was named Crane Pavilion Attendant; Du Jingqian, Luozhou marshal, was made acting supervisor of the Phoenix Pavilion Attendant; all joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.
315
戊寅，元綜流于振州。
On wuyin, Cui Yuanzong was exiled to Zhenzhou.
316
九月壬寅，昭德貶南賓尉。
In the ninth month, on renyin, Li Zhaode was demoted to captain of Nanbin.

In the tenth month, on renshen, Li Yuansu, right director of Wenchang, served as acting Phoenix Pavilion Attendant; Zhou Yun yuan, Right Attendant censor vice commissioner, was made acting supervisor of the Phoenix Pavilion Attendant; both joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

正月戊子，欽望貶趙州刺史，巨源鄜州刺史，景佺溱州刺史，味道集州刺史，元方綏州刺史。
In the first month, on wuzi, Dou Lu Qinwang was demoted to prefect of Zhao; Wei Juyuan to prefect of Bin; Du Jingqian to prefect of Zhen; Su Weidao to prefect of Ji; and Lu Yuanfang to prefect of Sui.

丙午，孝傑為朔方道行軍總管。

二月丙辰，允元薨。
In the second month, on bingchen, Zhou Yun yuan died.

323

In the third month, on renyin, Wang Xiaojie was dismissed.

On gengzi, Lou Shide was demoted to marshal of Yuanzhou.

七月辛亥，璹為榆關道安撫副大使。
In the seventh month, on xinhai, Yao Shuo was named deputy pacification commissioner of the Yuguang Circuit.

九月庚申，并州長史王方慶為鸞臺侍郎，殿中監李道廣，並同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

十月己卯，方慶為鳳閣侍郎。
In the tenth month, on jimao, Wang Fangqing was named Phoenix Pavilion Attendant.

In the first month, on renxu, Li Yuansu and Sun Yuanheng were executed.

In the fourth month, on guiyou, Wang Jishan, former chief administrator of the Yizhou area command, was named director of the Inner Secretariat.
332
五月癸卯，師德為清邊道行軍副大總管。
In the fifth month, on guimao, Lou Shide was appointed deputy grand commander of the Qingbian Circuit field army.

六月己卯，尚方少監宗楚客檢校夏官侍郎、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

On xinmao, Lou Shide was sent to pacify Hebei.

In the eighth month, on bingxu, Yao Shuo was relieved and appointed chief administrator of Yizhou.

On gengzi, Di Renjie was additionally named Chief of the Palace Secretariat; Wu Sansi was made acting supervisor of the Inner Secretariat; and Dou Lu Qinwang, from crown prince palace intendant, was named right chief councillor of Wenchang with rank equal to the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.

九月甲子，攸寧同鳳閣鸞臺三品。

二月庚申，武攸寧罷為冬官尚書。
In the second month, on gengshen, Wu Youning was relieved and appointed Minister of Winter.

In the eighth month, on gengxu, Wei Yuanzhong was appointed grand commander of the Longyou armies and prefectures.

九月辛丑，仁傑薨。
In the ninth month, on xinchou, Di Renjie died.

二月己酉，鸞臺侍郎李懷遠同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

In the third month, on jimao, Yao Yuanchong was named Phoenix Pavilion Attendant.

丙申，錫流循州。
On bingshen, Zhang Xi was exiled to Xunzhou.

四月癸丑，元崇往并州以北檢校諸軍州兵馬。

五月丁丑，元忠為靈武道行軍大總管。

六月庚申，元崇兼知夏官尚書事，夏官侍郎。 右奉宸內供奉李迥秀同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

七月壬午，味道充使往幽、平等州按察兵馬。

丁丑，嶠為成均祭酒、同鳳閣鸞臺三品。

壬午，元崇兼知夏官尚書、同鳳閣鸞臺三品。

七月丙戌，左肅政臺御史大夫楊再思守內史。

辛酉，元崇兼知春官尚書。

九月壬子，元之知群牧使，兼攝右肅政臺御史大夫、靈武道行軍大總管。

庚戌，玄暐守內史。 左羽林將軍敬暉、檢校左羽林將軍桓彥範並為納言。 柬之為天官尚書，恕己為鳳閣侍郎，並同鳳閣鸞臺三品。

二月甲寅，再思為戶部尚書、同中書門下三品。 元之罷為豪州刺史，韋承慶貶高要尉，融除名，流高州。
In the second month, on jiayin, Yang Zaisi was named Minister of Revenue with rank equal to the Three Departments. Zhang Yuanzhi was relieved and appointed prefect of Hao; Wei Chengqing was demoted to captain of Gaoyao; Fang Rong was dismissed, expunged from the rolls, and exiled to Gaozhou.

甲戌，太子少詹事祝欽明同中書門下三品，安石罷為守刑部尚書。

四月辛亥，恕己為中書令，彥範為侍中，柬之為天官尚書。

丁卯，元忠為衛尉卿、同中書門下平章事。
On dingmao, Wei Yuanzhong was named court commandant and joined the Secretariat and Palace Secretariat in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

辛未，暉為侍中。
On xinwei, Jing Hui was appointed Palace Secretariat Attendant.

甲戌，元忠為兵部尚書，安石為吏部尚書，懷遠為左散騎常侍，休璟自涼州入為輔國大將軍，並同中書門下三品。 再思檢校揚州大都督。 玄暐為特進，檢校益州大都督府長史、同中書門下三品。 欽明守刑部尚書。
On jiaxu, Wei Yuanzhong was named Minister of War; Wei Anshi Minister of Personnel; Li Huaiyuan Left Regular Attendant; Tang Xiujing, arriving from Liangzhou, Assistant State-supporting Grand General; all with rank equal to the Three Departments. Yang Zaisi was made acting supervisor of the Yangzhou area command. Cui Xuanwei was made specially advanced and acting supervisor of the chief administrator of the Yizhou area command with rank equal to the Three Departments. Zhu Qinming served as acting Minister of Justice.

乙亥，柬之為中書令、同中書門下三品。
On yihai, Zhang Jianzhi was named Director of the Secretariat with rank equal to the Three Departments.

五月甲午，安石兼檢校中書令。 玄暐罷為博陵郡王，柬之罷為漢陽郡王，恕己罷為南陽郡王，暉罷為平陽郡王，彥範罷為扶陽郡王，元忠兼侍中。
In the fifth month, on jiawu, Wei Anshi was additionally made acting supervisor of the Director of the Secretariat. Cui Xuanwei was relieved and enfeoffed as Prince of Boling; Zhang Jianzhi as Prince of Hanyang; Yuan Shuji as Prince of Nanyang; Jing Hui as Prince of Pingyang; Huan Yanfan as Prince of Fuyang; Wei Yuanzhong was additionally named Palace Secretariat Attendant.
442
庚子，懷遠為左散騎常侍。
On gengzi, Li Huaiyuan was named Left Regular Attendant.
443
甲辰，休璟為尚書左僕射，欽望自特進為右僕射、同中書門下平章事。
On jiachen, Tang Xiujing was appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Dou Lu Qinwang, from specially advanced, Right Vice Director, deliberating jointly on state affairs with the Secretariat and Palace Secretariat.
444
六月癸亥，欽望軍國重事中書門下平章，安石為中書令，元忠為侍中，再思檢校中書令。
In the sixth month, on guihai, Dou Lu Qinwang joined the Secretariat and Palace Secretariat in deliberating jointly on military and state affairs; Wei Anshi was named Director of the Secretariat; Wei Yuanzhong Palace Secretariat Attendant; and Yang Zaisi served as acting Director of the Secretariat.
445
七月辛巳，太子賓客韋巨源同中書門下三品。
In the seventh month, on xinsi, Wei Juyuan, crown prince guest, was given rank equal to the Three Departments.
446
八月，欽望兼檢校安國相王府長史。
In the eighth month, Dou Lu Qinwang was additionally made acting supervisor of the chief administrator of the Prince of An Guo's household.
447
九月癸巳，巨源罷為禮部尚書。
In the ninth month, on guisi, Wei Juyuan was relieved and appointed Minister of Rites.
448
十月丁未，休璟為京留守，仍判尚書省事。
In the tenth month, on dingwei, Tang Xiujing was named capital guardian of Jing, still adjudicating Department of State Affairs affairs.
449
辛未，元忠為中書令，再思行侍中。
On xinwei, Wei Yuanzhong was named Director of the Secretariat; Yang Zaisi served as acting Palace Secretariat Attendant.
450
正月丙午，安國相王為太尉。
In the first month, on bingwu, Prince of An Guo was named Grand Marshal.
451
二月丙寅，梁王武三思為司空、同中書門下三品。
In the second month, on bingyin, Prince of Liang Wu Sansi was named Minister of Works with rank equal to the Three Departments.
452
丁卯，右散騎常侍武攸暨為司徒。
On dingmao, Wu Youji, Right Regular Attendant, was named Minister of Education.
453
辛未，安國相王讓太尉、同三品。
On xinwei, Prince of An Guo relinquished the grand marshalship and received rank equal to the Three Departments.
454
丁丑，三思、攸暨罷。
On dingchou, Wu Sansi and Wu Youji were dismissed.
455
正月戊戌，守吏部尚書李嶠同中書門下三品，中書侍郎于惟謙同中書門下平章事。
In the first month, on wuxu, Li Jiao, acting Minister of Personnel, was given rank equal to the Three Departments; Yu Weiqian, Secretariat Attendant, joined the Secretariat and Palace Secretariat in deliberating jointly on state affairs.
456
二月乙未，禮部尚書韋巨源守刑部尚書、同中書門下三品。
In the second month, on yiwei, Wei Juyuan, Minister of Rites, served as acting Minister of Justice with rank equal to the Three Departments.
457
三月甲辰，安石罷為戶部尚書。 戶部尚書蘇瑰守侍中。
In the third month, on jiachen, Wei Anshi was relieved and appointed Minister of Revenue. Su Gui, Minister of Revenue, served as acting Palace Secretariat Attendant.
458
戊申，休璟致仕。
On wushen, Tang Xiujing retired from office.
459
四月己丑，懷遠致仕。
In the fourth month, on jichou, Li Huaiyuan retired from office.
460
六月戊寅，貶暉為崖州司馬，彥範瀧州司馬，恕己竇州司馬，玄暐白州司馬，柬之新州司馬。
In the sixth month, on wuyin, Jing Hui was demoted to marshal of Yazhou; Huan Yanfan to Longzhou; Yuan Shuji to Douzhou; Cui Xuanwei to Baizhou; and Zhang Jianzhi to Xinzhou.
461
七月丙寅，元忠為尚書右僕射、兼中書令，仍知兵部事。 嶠守中書令。
In the seventh month, on bingyin, Wei Yuanzhong was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and concurrent Director of the Secretariat, still in charge of Ministry of War affairs. Li Jiao served as acting Director of the Secretariat.
462
辛未，懷遠復為同中書門下三品。 流暉于嘉州，彥範于瀼州，恕己于環州，玄暐于古州，柬之于瀧州。
On xinwei, Li Huaiyuan again received rank equal to the Three Departments. Jing Hui was exiled to Jiazhou, Huan Yanfan to Rangzhou, Yuan Shuji to Huanzhou, Cui Xuanwei to Guzhou, and Zhang Jianzhi to Longzhou.
463
八月丙子，欽明貶申州刺史。
In the eighth month, on bingzi, Zhu Qinming was demoted to prefect of Shen.
464
九月戊午，懷遠薨。
In the ninth month, on wuwu, Li Huaiyuan died.
465
十月癸巳，瑰為侍中。
In the tenth month, on guisi, Su Gui was named Palace Secretariat Attendant.
466
十二月丙申，欽望為開府儀同三司，依舊平章軍國重事。 元忠為尚書左僕射。
In the twelfth month, on bingshen, Dou Lu Qinwang was named honored companion of the first rank, still charged to deliberate jointly on military and state affairs as before. Wei Yuanzhong was appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
467
七月壬戌，嶠為中書令，巨源為吏部尚書，元忠加特進。
In the seventh month, on renxu, Li Jiao was named Director of the Secretariat; Wei Juyuan Minister of Personnel; and Wei Yuanzhong was promoted to specially advanced.
468
八月丙戌，元忠以特進致仕。
In the eighth month, on bingxu, Wei Yuanzhong retired with the rank of specially advanced.
469
九月丁酉，惟謙罷為國子祭酒。 行兵部尚書宗楚客左衛將軍，兼太府卿紀處訥為太僕卿，吏部侍郎蕭至忠為黃門侍郎，並同中書門下三品。
In the ninth month, on dingyou, Yu Weiqian was relieved and appointed director of the directorate of education. Zong Chuke, acting Minister of War, was named general of the Left Guard; Ji Chune, court of the imperial stud director, grand herald; Xiao Zhizhong, Vice Minister of Personnel, Yellow Gate Attendant; all with rank equal to the Three Departments.
470
丙辰，至忠行中書侍郎。
On bingchen, Xiao Zhizhong served as acting Secretariat Attendant.
471
辛亥，再思為中書令，巨源、處訥為侍中。 瑰罷為行吏部尚書。
On xinhai, Yang Zaisi was named Director of the Secretariat; Wei Juyuan and Ji Chune Palace Secretariat Attendants. Su Gui was relieved and appointed acting Minister of Personnel.
472
七月癸巳，左屯衛大將軍、朔方道行軍大總管張仁亶同中書門下三品。
In the seventh month, on guisi, Zhang Renbian, general of the Left Encampment Guard and grand commander of the Shuofang Circuit field army, was given rank equal to the Three Departments.
473
二月壬寅，巨源為尚書左僕射，再思為右僕射，同中書門下三品。
In the second month, on renyin, Wei Juyuan was appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Yang Zaisi Right Vice Director; both with rank equal to the Three Departments.
474
三月戊午，楚客為中書令，至忠守侍中，太府卿韋嗣立守兵部尚書、同中書門下三品。 中書侍郎兼檢校吏部侍郎崔湜，守兵部侍郎趙彥昭為中書侍郎，並同中書門下平章事。
In the third month, on wuwu, Zong Chuke was named Director of the Secretariat; Xiao Zhizhong served as acting Palace Secretariat Attendant; and Wei Sili, court of the imperial stud director, served as acting Minister of War with rank equal to the Three Departments. Cui Shi, Secretariat Attendant and acting Vice Minister of Personnel, and Zhao Yanzhao, acting Vice Minister of War and Secretariat Attendant, both joined the Secretariat and Palace Secretariat in deliberating jointly on state affairs.
475
戊寅，禮部尚書韋溫為太子少保、同中書門下三品，太常少卿鄭愔守吏部侍郎、同中書門下平章事。
On wuyin, Wei Wen, Minister of Rites, was named junior guardian of the crown prince with rank equal to the Three Departments; Zheng Yin, court of imperial sacrifices vice director, served as acting Vice Minister of Personnel and joined the Secretariat and Palace Secretariat in deliberating jointly on state affairs.
476
五月丙戌，湜貶襄州刺史，愔貶江州司馬。
In the fifth month, on bingxu, Cui Shi was demoted to prefect of Xiang and Zheng Yin to marshal of Jiangzhou.
477
六月癸卯，再思薨。
In the sixth month, on guimao, Yang Zaisi died.
478
八月乙酉，嶠守兵部尚書、同中書門下三品，安石自特進為侍中，至忠為中書令。
In the eighth month, on yiyou, Li Jiao served as acting Minister of War with rank equal to the Three Departments; Wei Anshi, from specially advanced, was named Palace Secretariat Attendant; and Xiao Zhizhong Director of the Secretariat.
479
九月，巨源為都留守。
In the ninth month, Wei Juyuan was named capital guardian.
480
戊辰，瑰為右僕射、同中書門下三品。
On wuchen, Su Gui was appointed Right Vice Director with rank equal to the Three Departments.
481
十一月甲戌，欽望薨。
In the eleventh month, on jiaxu, Dou Lu Qinwang died.
482
十二月壬辰，前右僕射、同三品、宋國公致仕唐休璟為太子少師、同中書門下三品。
In the twelfth month, on renchen, Tang Xiujing, former right vice director with rank equal to the Three Departments and retired Duke of Song, was named junior mentor of the crown prince with rank equal to the Three Departments.
483
六月壬午，工部尚書張錫、刑部尚書裴談並同中書門下三品，吏部侍郎崔湜、中書侍郎岑羲、吏部尚書張嘉福並同中書門下平章事，溫總知內外兵馬。
In the sixth month, on renwu, Zhang Xi, Minister of Works, and Pei Tan, Minister of Justice, both received rank equal to the Three Departments; Cui Shi, Vice Minister of Personnel, Cen Xi, Secretariat Attendant, and Zhang Jiafu, Minister of Personnel, joined the Secretariat and Palace Secretariat in deliberating jointly on state affairs; Wei Wen overall supervisor of internal and external military and cavalry affairs.
484
甲申，相王參謀政事。
On jiashen, Prince of Xiang joined deliberations on governmental affairs.
485
壬辰，嘉福持節河北道巡撫，羲持節河南道巡撫，處訥持節關內道巡撫。
On renchen, Zhang Jiafu was dispatched with imperial staff as Hebei Circuit inspector; Cen Xi as Henan Circuit inspector; and Ji Chune as Guannei Circuit inspector.
486
庚子，巨源誅。
On gengzi, Wei Juyuan was put to death.
487
辛丑，朝邑尉劉幽求為中書舍人，苑總監鍾紹京為中書侍郎，並參豫機務。
On xinchou, Liu Youqiu, captain of Chaoyi, was named draftsman of the Secretariat; Zhong Shaojing, park director, Secretariat Attendant; both joined in managing confidential affairs.
488
壬寅，紹京、黃門侍郎李日知、殿中監平王隆基並同中書門下三品。 至忠貶許州刺史，嗣立宋州刺史，彥昭絳州刺史，湜華州刺史。 處訥、楚客、溫誅。
On renyin, Zhong Shaojing, Li Rizhi, Yellow Gate Attendant, and Li Longji, Prince of Ping and palace domestic office supervisor, all received rank equal to the Three Departments. Xiao Zhizhong was demoted to prefect of Xu; Wei Sili to Song; Zhao Yanzhao to Jiang; and Cui Shi to Hua. Ji Chune, Zong Chuke, and Wei Wen were put to death.
489
癸卯，隆基同中書門下三品。 紹京行中書令。 嘉福誅。
On guimao, Li Longji received rank equal to the Three Departments. Zhong Shaojing served as acting Director of the Secretariat. Zhang Jiafu was put to death.
490
乙巳，紹京罷為戶部尚書。
On yisi, Zhong Shaojing was relieved and appointed Minister of Revenue.
491
丙午，太常少卿薛稷為黃門侍郎，參豫機務。
On bingwu, Xue Ji, court of imperial sacrifices vice director, was named Yellow Gate Attendant and joined in managing confidential affairs.
492
丁未，隆基為皇太子。
On dingwei, Li Longji was established as crown prince.
493
戊申，許州刺史姚元之為兵部尚書、同中書門下三品； 嗣立、至忠為中書令； 彥昭為中書侍郎，湜為吏部侍郎、同中書門下平章事。
On wushen, Yao Yuanchong, prefect of Xu, was named Minister of War with rank equal to the Three Departments; Wei Sili and Xiao Zhizhong were named Directors of the Secretariat; Zhao Yanzhao Secretariat Attendant; Cui Shi Vice Minister of Personnel, joining the Secretariat and Palace Secretariat in deliberating jointly on state affairs.
494
七月癸丑，兵部尚書崔日用行黃門侍郎，參知機務； 稷為中書侍郎。
In the seventh month, on guichou, Cui Riyong, Minister of War, served as acting Yellow Gate Attendant and joined in managing confidential affairs; Xue Ji was named Secretariat Attendant.
495
丁巳，洛州長史宋璟檢校吏部尚書同中書門下三品，元之兼太子左庶子，璟兼右庶子。 羲罷為右散騎常侍。
On dingsi, Song Jing, chief administrator of Luozhou, was made acting supervisor of the Ministry of Personnel with rank equal to the Three Departments; Yao Yuanchong additionally crown prince left senior support; Song Jing additionally right senior support. Cen Xi was relieved and appointed Right Regular Attendant.
496
壬戌，湜罷為尚書左丞，錫貶絳州刺史，至忠為晉州刺史，彥昭為宋州刺史，嗣立為許州刺史。
On renxu, Cui Shi was relieved and appointed left director of the Department of State Affairs; Zhang Xi demoted to prefect of Jiang; Xiao Zhizhong to Jin; Zhao Yanzhao to Song; and Wei Sili to Xu.
497
丙寅，元之兼中書令，瑰為尚書左僕射。 嶠貶為懷州刺史。
On bingyin, Yao Yuanchong was additionally named Director of the Secretariat; Su Gui Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs. Li Jiao was demoted to prefect of Huai.
498
丁卯，休璟致仕，仁亶罷為左衛大將軍。
On dingmao, Tang Xiujing retired; Zhang Renbian was relieved and appointed general of the Left Guard.
499
己巳，日用罷為雍州刺史，稷罷為左散騎常侍。
On jisi, Cui Riyong was relieved and appointed governor of Yongzhou; Xue Ji relieved and appointed Left Regular Attendant.
500
八月癸巳，談罷為蒲州刺史。
In the eighth month, on guisi, Pei Tan was relieved and appointed prefect of Pu.
501
十一月戊申，元崇為中書令兼兵部尚書。
In the eleventh month, on wushen, Yao Yuanchong was named Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of War.
502
壬子，安石罷為太子少保，瑰罷為少傅。 宋王成器為尚書左僕射。
On renzi, Wei Anshi was relieved and appointed junior preceptor of the crown prince; Su Gui junior mentor of the crown prince. Prince of Song Li Chengq was appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
503
六月甲申，安國相王罷參謀政事，加太尉。
In the sixth month, on jiashen, Prince of An Guo ceased deliberating on governmental affairs and was promoted to Grand Marshal.
504
十一月己巳，宋王成器為司徒兼揚州大都督。
In the eleventh month, on jisi, Prince of Song Li Chengq was named Minister of Education and concurrent Yangzhou area commander.
505
正月己未，太僕卿郭元振、中書侍郎張說並同中書門下平章事。
In the first month, on jiwei, Guo Yuanzhen, grand herald, and Zhang Yue, Secretariat Attendant, both joined the Secretariat and Palace Secretariat in deliberating jointly on state affairs.
506
二月甲申，璟貶楚州刺史，元之申州刺史。
In the second month, on jiashen, Song Jing was demoted to prefect of Chu and Yao Yuanchong to Shen.
507
丙戌，韋安石為侍中，幽求罷為戶部尚書。
On bingxu, Wei Anshi was named Palace Secretariat Attendant; Liu Youqiu relieved and appointed Minister of Revenue.
508
四月甲申，安石為中書令。
In the fourth month, on jiashen, Wei Anshi was named Director of the Secretariat.
509
辛卯，日知守侍中。
On xinmao, Li Rizhi served as acting Palace Secretariat Attendant.
510
庚戌，安石加開府儀同三司。
On gengxu, Wei Anshi was promoted to honored companion of the first rank.
511
壬戌，殿中監竇懷貞為左臺御史大夫、同中書門下平章事。
On renxu, Dou Huaizhen, palace domestic office supervisor, was named Left Terrace Censor-in-Chief and joined the Secretariat and Palace Secretariat in deliberating jointly on state affairs.
512
八月庚午，安石為尚書左僕射、同中書門下三品。
In the eighth month, on gengwu, Wei Anshi was appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs with rank equal to the Three Departments.
513
九月乙亥，懷貞守侍中。
In the ninth month, on yihai, Dou Huaizhen served as acting Palace Secretariat Attendant.
514
十月甲辰，日知罷為戶部尚書，元振罷為吏部尚書，說罷為尚書左丞，懷貞罷為左臺御史大夫，安石罷為特進。 中書侍郎陸象先同中書門下平章事。 吏部尚書劉幽求為侍中，右散騎常侍魏知古，太子詹事崔湜為中書侍郎，並同中書門下三品。
In the tenth month, on jiachen, Li Rizhi was relieved and appointed Minister of Revenue; Guo Yuanzhen Minister of Personnel; Zhang Yue left director of the Department of State Affairs; Dou Huaizhen Left Terrace Censor-in-Chief; and Wei Anshi specially advanced. Lu Xiangxian, Secretariat Attendant, joined the Secretariat and Palace Secretariat in deliberating jointly on state affairs. Liu Youqiu, Minister of Personnel, Palace Secretariat Attendant; Wei Zhigu, Right Regular Attendant; Cui Shi, crown prince household administrator and Secretariat Attendant; all with rank equal to the Three Departments.
515
四月甲申，宋王憲讓司徒為太子賓客。
In the fourth month, on jiashen, Prince of Song Li Xian relinquished the minister of education and became crown prince guest.
516
正月壬辰，象先同中書門下三品。
In the first month, on renchen, Lu Xiangxian received rank equal to the Three Departments.
517
乙未，竇懷貞、戶部尚書岑羲並同中書門下三品。
On yiwei, Dou Huaizhen and Cen Xi, Minister of Revenue, both received rank equal to the Three Departments.
518
六月癸丑，羲為侍中。
In the sixth month, on guichou, Cen Xi was named Palace Secretariat Attendant.
519
壬戌，知古為戶部尚書、同中書門下三品。
On renxu, Wei Zhigu was named Minister of Revenue with rank equal to the Three Departments.
520
七月乙亥，懷貞為尚書右僕射、軍國重事宜共平章。
In the seventh month, on yihai, Dou Huaizhen was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, with weighty military and state affairs to be deliberated jointly.
521
八月庚戌，湜檢校中書令； 幽求守尚書右僕射，懷貞守左僕射，並同三品； 知古守侍中。
In the eighth month, on gengxu, Cui Shi was made acting supervisor of the Director of the Secretariat; Liu Youqiu served as acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Dou Huaizhen acting Left Vice Director; both with rank equal to the Three Departments; Wei Zhigu served as acting Palace Secretariat Attendant.
522
戊午，幽求流于封州。
On wuwu, Liu Youqiu was exiled to Fengzhou.
523
八月己酉，宋王成器為司空。
In the eighth month, on jiyou, Prince of Song Li Chengq was named Minister of Works.
